P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait is present on the page; the left column contains only a QR code and a pull quote block, with no human face visible.

P05.rationale: The client portrait area in the left column is replaced entirely by a QR code image, with no named person portrait at any meaningful size.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus beyond a single pull quote, which does not constitute a social-proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: A large ghost numeral '4' appears faintly in the top-right corner, providing a minimal decorative typographic element, though it is quite subtle and small.

P11.rationale: Three metric boxes (30→2 min, 60→5 min, 3 workflows) present before/after data, but they are simple text callouts rather than visual data-visualisations or charts.

P12.rationale: The lower half of the page is largely empty with only text paragraphs and significant dead space below the content, making the layout feel sparse rather than magazine-dense.

P13.rationale: The background is entirely flat white with no texture, atmosphere, or tonal treatment applied anywhere on the page.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so this criterion is not applicable; score reflects absence of the device.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The QR code placeholder and absence of any real client photography make the page feel generic and non-specific to an actual business.

N08.rationale: The bottom third of the page is almost entirely blank white space with no content, representing significant purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: There is no full-bleed photo with overlaid text anywhere on the page, so no scrim issue exists.
